ISTE.why: sells FOUP cleaners (incl. a 400mm FOUP cleaner for HBM in mass production), wafer sorters / EFEM and SiCN PECVD tools to memory makers, mainly SK Hynix; semiconductor equipment was 93.29% of H1 2026 revenue
ISTE.evidence: DART half-year report 08-13-2026: semiconductor equipment (FOUP Cleaner, Sorter, EFEM, Shelf, parts) is the main business and the main customers are SK Hynix, Samsung Electronics, SK Siltron and Soitec; FOUP cleaner supply contracts with SK Hynix disclosed 2026-02-09, 2026-02-20 and 2026-03-26

players.product: FOUP cleaners incl. 400mm HBM FOUP cleaner (NFC400), wafer sorters / EFEM, and SiCN PECVD (SiRiUS) incl. low-temperature SiCN for hybrid bonding

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 half-year report (DART, filed 08-13-2026, consolidated): H1 revenue KRW 23,232,198,687 vs KRW 13,689,349,166 in H1 2025; H1 operating profit KRW 2,608,276,122 vs an operating loss of KRW 595,248,337. Q2 alone: revenue KRW 16,849,737,146 (Q2 2025: KRW 3,360,588,560), operating profit KRW 2,073,401,486 (Q2 2025: loss of KRW 901,840,774). Equipment business revenue KRW 21,696,182 thousand (93.4%) with operating profit KRW 3,178,046 thousand (a 14.6% margin); within it FOUP cleaners KRW 15,150,666 thousand and semiconductor automation KRW 4,389,000 thousand. Hydrogen-energy business revenue KRW 1,536,016 thousand with an operating loss of KRW 569,769 thousand. The company attributes the growth to better ordering conditions and resumed orders at major semiconductor customers, partly offset by delayed OLED orders.

Order backlog at 06-30-2026: KRW 41,396,058 thousand -- FOUP cleaners KRW 7,215,976 thousand (orders KRW 22,380,357 thousand from 2025-11 to 2026-06, delivery through 2026-12), semiconductor automation KRW 725,000 thousand, other equipment KRW 330,555 thousand and hydrogen-energy EPC KRW 33,124,527 thousand (incl. a KRW 23,500,000,000 pyrolysis plant contract with Geumgang ENT signed 2026-04-22, running to 2028-01-31). Customer A (equipment) accounted for KRW 16,103,976 thousand of H1 2026 revenue. Management says the backlog gives a favourable base for improved results from Q3.
quarterly_data.figure: Backlog KRW 41,396,058 thousand (FOUP cleaners KRW 7,215,976 thousand); customer A KRW 16,103,976 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity and utilisation, H1 2026: FOUP cleaners (VFC301 basis) capacity 30 sets, produced 24, utilisation 80% (FY2025: 23%); semiconductor automation (sorter) capacity 45, produced 33, 73% (FY2025: 2%); PECVD (SiRiUS) capacity 6, none produced (one unit in FY2025). To expand capacity the company is acquiring industrial land in Anseong Technovalley (6,165 m2, total KRW 3,496,714 thousand, 2022-05 to 2026-12) and the 2nd Yongin Technovalley (6,256 m2, total KRW 10,069,113 thousand, 2024-06 to 2027-06); buildings will be decided by the board later.
quarterly_data.figure: FOUP cleaner utilisation 80% (24 of 30); sorter 73% (33 of 45)

quarterly_data.signal: HBM and PECVD products: a 400mm FOUP cleaner for HBM (NFC400, developed 2023-2024) is in mass production and a vacuum-type 400mm HBM FOUP cleaner (VFC400) is in development for 2026-2027; a patent for an HBM carrier cleaning device was registered on 2026-07-16; a FOUP inspection-and-cleaner combo (NFIC300) is in mass production. The company sold its first SiCN PECVD tool in November 2025 (PECVD revenue KRW 2,423,000 thousand in FY2025) and has developed a low-temperature SiCN PECVD system for package hybrid bonding; a dual-frequency high-carbon SiCN PECVD is in development (2023-2027). Semiconductor equipment customers now number more than 10, versus mainly SK Hynix in the past. H1 R&D spend KRW 746,482 thousand.
quarterly_data.figure: First SiCN PECVD sale November 2025; HBM FOUP cleaner NFC400 in mass production

quarterly_data.signal: New AI data-center server business: in December 2025 the company signed a two-year service agreement with Pegatron to support sales of Pegatron AI data-center servers (NVIDIA HGX B300 air- and liquid-cooled, MGX RTX Pro 6000, rack scale) to Korean customers, paid as a share of Pegatron's order value; it completed a proof of concept with Korea's largest CSP in June 2026 and expects about KRW 800 million of sales-support investment over two years.
quarterly_data.figure: Pegatron service agreement 2025-12-05 (2 years); ~KRW 800 million investment

contracts.signal: Semiconductor automation equipment sale to SK Hynix disclosed 2026-01-22: KRW 4,389,000,000 (10.68% of revenue), term to 2026-10-01; delivery complete and 90% of the price received.

FOUP cleaner sales to SK Hynix: KRW 2,300,000,000 disclosed 2026-02-09 (5.60% of revenue, to 2026-07-21, 50% delivered); KRW 6,841,225,000 disclosed 2026-02-20 (16.65% of revenue, to 2026-09-15, 88% delivered); KRW 2,873,725,000 disclosed 2026-03-26 (6.99% of revenue, to 2027-05-31, delivery to start). SK Hynix has been the company's main customer since it registered as an SK Hynix business partner in 2016.
